public_health_question.v: What risk factors explain an M. abscessus outbreak among ventilator-dependent residents of a pediatric facility, and what IPC measures should be recommended?

ev.q: PADOH investigated this outbreak to identify risk factors and recommend infection prevention and control (IPC) measures.
Mycobacterium abscessus Outbreak Related to Contaminated Water Among Ventilator-Dependent Residents of a Pediatric Facility
M. abscessus –positive respiratory isolates from ventilator-dependent residents of a 34-bed pediatric facility.
PADOH investigated this outbreak to identify risk factors and recommend infection prevention and control (IPC) measures.
On October 12, PADOH conducted a site visit to observe IPC practices.
On October 31, PADOH collected 21 environmental samples from faucets, aerators, showerheads and drains, filtered water and ice machines

equity.level_reason: Age defines the population only (pediatric facility residents); ventilator dependence is clinical status; no social-position framing.

level_alternative.reason: The congregate residential setting and licensing gaps could be read as a structural factor, but it is not tied to a social-position group.

ev.q: ventilator-dependent residents of a 34-bed pediatric facility.

notes: Three-case cluster with environmental sampling; HPC values are judged against the EPA ≤500 CFU/mL threshold (recorded as a fixed referent). Hand-hygiene compliance (30/37) is an inspection count, not a comparison. No statistical methods are stated.
